verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ لَا تَغَرْ مِنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ، وَلَا تَحْسِدْ عُمَّالَ ٱلْإِثْمِ،
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.web: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ مِثْلَ ٱلْحَشِيشِ سَرِيعًا يُقْطَعُونَ، وَمِثْلَ ٱلْعُشْبِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ يَذْبُلُونَ.
verses.kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.web: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

verses.ar: ٱتَّكِلْ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ وَٱفْعَلِ ٱلْخَيْرَ. ٱسْكُنِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱرْعَ ٱلْأَمَانَةَ.
verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD, and do good; [so] shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

verses.ar: وَتَلَذَّذْ بِٱلرَّبِّ فَيُعْطِيَكَ سُؤْلَ قَلْبِكَ.
verses.kjv: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

verses.ar: سَلِّمْ لِلرَّبِّ طَرِيقَكَ وَٱتَّكِلْ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يُجْرِي،
verses.kjv: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass.
verses.web: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

verses.ar: وَيُخْرِجُ مِثْلَ ٱلنُّورِ بِرَّكَ، وَحَقَّكَ مِثْلَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ.
verses.kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.web: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

verses.ar: ٱنْتَظِرِ ٱلرَّبَّ وَٱصْبِرْ لَهُ، وَلَا تَغَرْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِي يَنْجَحُ فِي طَرِيقِهِ، مِنَ ٱلرَّجُلِ ٱلْمُجْرِي مَكَايِدَ.
verses.kjv: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.web: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

verses.ar: كُفَّ عَنِ ٱلْغَضَبِ، وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلسَّخَطَ، وَلَا تَغَرْ لِفِعْلِ ٱلشَّرِّ،
verses.kjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ عَامِلِي ٱلشَّرِّ يُقْطَعُونَ، وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنْتَظِرُونَ ٱلرَّبَّ هُمْ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

verses.ar: بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍلَا يَكُونُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ تَطَّلِعُ فِي مَكَانِهِ فَلَا يَكُونُ.
verses.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked [shall] not [be:] yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it [shall] not [be].
verses.web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْوُدَعَاءُ فَيَرِثُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَيَتَلَذَّذُونَ فِي كَثْرَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.web: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يَتَفَكَّرُ ضِدَّ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ وَيُحَرِّقُ عَلَيْهِ أَسْنَانَهُ.
verses.kjv: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.web: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَضْحَكُ بِهِ لِأَنَّهُ رَأَى أَنَّ يَوْمَهُ آتٍ!
verses.kjv: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.web: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَشْرَارُ قَدْ سَلُّوا ٱلسَّيْفَ وَمَدُّوا قَوْسَهُمْ لِرَمْيِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ وَٱلْفَقِيرِ، لِقَتْلِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ طَرِيقُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, [and] to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

verses.ar: سَيْفُهُمْ يَدْخُلُ فِي قَلْبِهِمْ، وَقِسِيُّهُمْ تَنْكَسِرُ.
verses.kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.web: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

verses.ar: اَلْقَلِيلُ ٱلَّذِي لِلصِّدِّيقِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ ثَرْوَةِ أَشْرَارٍ كَثِيرِينَ.
verses.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath [is] better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ سَوَاعِدَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ تَنْكَسِرُ، وَعَاضِدُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ عَارِفٌ أَيَّامَ ٱلْكَمَلَةِ، وَمِيرَاثُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يَكُونُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.web: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

verses.ar: لَا يُخْزَوْنَ فِي زَمَنِ ٱلسُّوءِ، وَفِي أَيَّامِ ٱلْجُوعِ يَشْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْأَشْرَارَ يَهْلِكُونَ، وَأَعْدَاءُ ٱلرَّبِّ كَبَهَاءِ ٱلْمَرَاعِي. فَنُوا. كَٱلدُّخَانِ فَنُوا.
verses.kjv: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD [shall be] as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.web: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يَسْتَقْرِضُ وَلَا يَفِي، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ فَيَتَرَأَّفُ وَيُعْطِي.
verses.kjv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.web: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْمُبَارَكِينَ مِنْهُ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَٱلْمَلْعُونِينَ مِنْهُ يُقْطَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: For [such as be] blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and [they that be] cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

verses.ar: مِنْ قِبَلِ ٱلرَّبِّ تَتَثَبَّتُ خَطَوَاتُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ وَفِي طَرِيقِهِ يُسَرُّ.
verses.kjv: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.web: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

verses.ar: إِذَا سَقَطَ لَا يَنْطَرِحُ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مُسْنِدٌ يَدَهُ.
verses.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth [him with] his hand.
verses.web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا كُنْتُ فَتىً وَقَدْ شِخْتُ، وَلَمْ أَرَ صِدِّيقًا تُخُلِّيَ عَنْهُ، وَلَا ذُرِّيَّةً لَهُ تَلْتَمِسُ خُبْزًا.
verses.kjv: I have been young, and [now] am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

verses.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ يَتَرَأَّفُ وَيُقْرِضُ، وَنَسْلُهُ لِلْبَرَكَةِ.
verses.kjv: [He is] ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed [is] blessed.
verses.web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

verses.ar: حِدْ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ وَٱفْعَلِ ٱلْخَيْرَ، وَٱسْكُنْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.web: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يُحِبُّ ٱلْحَقَّ، وَلَا يَتَخَلَّى عَنْ أَتْقِيَائِهِ. إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يُحْفَظُونَ. أَمَّا نَسْلُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَيَنْقَطِعُ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.web: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.ar: ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَيَسْكُنُونَهَا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

verses.ar: فَمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ يَلْهَجُ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ، وَلِسَانُهُ يَنْطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ.
verses.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

verses.ar: شَرِيعَةُ إِلَهِهِ فِي قَلْبِهِ. لَا تَتَقَلْقَلُ خَطَوَاتُهُ.
verses.kjv: The law of his God [is] in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.web: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يُرَاقِبُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَ مُحَاوِلًا أَنْ يُمِيتَهُ.
verses.kjv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.web: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ لَا يَتْرُكُهُ فِي يَدِهِ، وَلَا يَحْكُمُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ مُحَاكَمَتِهِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.web: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.ar: ٱنْتَظِرِ ٱلرَّبَّ وَٱحْفَظْ طَرِيقَهُ، فَيَرْفَعَكَ لِتَرِثَ ٱلْأَرْضَ. إِلَى ٱنْقِرَاضِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ تَنْظُرُ.
verses.kjv: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].
verses.web: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

verses.ar: قَدْ رَأَيْتُ ٱلشِّرِّيرَ عَاتِيًا، وَارِفًا مِثْلَ شَجَرَةٍ شَارِقَةٍ نَاضِرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.web: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

verses.ar: عَبَرَ فَإِذَا هُوَ لَيْسَ بِمَوْجُودٍ، وَٱلْتَمَسْتُهُ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ.
verses.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he [was] not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.ar: لَاحِظِ ٱلْكَامِلَ وَٱنْظُرِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ، فَإِنَّ ٱلْعَقِبَ لِإِنْسَانِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: Mark the perfect [man], and behold the upright: for the end of [that] man [is] peace.
verses.web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْأَشْرَارُ فَيُبَادُونَ جَمِيعًا. عَقِبُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يَنْقَطِعُ.
verses.kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.web: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.ar: أَمَّا خَلَاصُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ فَمِنْ قِبَلِ ٱلرَّبِّ، حِصْنِهمْ فِي زَمَانِ ٱلضِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous [is] of the LORD: [he is] their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.web: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

verses.ar: وَيُعِينُهُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ وَيُنَجِّيهِمْ. يُنْقِذُهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ وَيُخَلِّصُهُمْ، لِأَنَّهُمُ ٱحْتَمَوْا بِهِ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.web: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
